freeze: TorchBoost HIGGS differentiable residual adapter final shadow evaluation v1

training.residual_structure: one zero-at-birth affine tree refinement in every hidden layer
training.checkpoint_selection: lowest selection NLL over adapter epochs

shadow.evaluation: evaluate both predeclared arms for all three independent seeds and report every seed plus unweighted mean
shadow.selection_rule: none; shadow metrics may not choose a seed, checkpoint, architecture, hyperparameter, or follow-up configuration

decision: The shadow audit is a one-way final evaluation of the frozen 500k development architecture. Whatever it reports is retained.
superseded_reason: A matched train-scale causal control and split architecture/checkpoint selection protocol were introduced after this freeze. Final shadow evaluation must wait for the corrected causal-control and external-transfer studies, then use a new freeze manifest.
